title: The Y Combinator CEO Just Open-Sourced His Entire AI Setup
description:
Garry Tan, CEO of Y Combinator, open-sourced his exact Claude Code setup on GitHub.
It's called gstack. 23 tools that turn Claude Code into a full team.
CEO, designer, engineering manager, release manager, QA. All built in.
Over 64,000 stars on GitHub. One-command install. Completely free.

Link: https://github.com/garrytan/gstack
channel_name: Brock Mesarich | AI for Non Techies
transcript: The CEO of Y Combinator just open-sourced his entire AI setup on GitHub and you can install it in one command. It's called G stack. It's 23 tools that turn Claude code into an entire team. CEO, designer, engineering manager, release manager, and Q&A. All built in. Gary Tan runs the biggest startup accelerator in the world and this is the exact system he uses every single day. You install it once and Claude code doesn't just write code anymore. It plans projects, reviews designs, manages releases, writes documentation, and tests everything before it ships. The repo already has 64,000 stars and it's completely free and open-source. This was built by somebody running a billion-dollar operation, so every tool in here solves a real problem. Comment G stack and I'll send you the link to set it up.
